description: Why: a leaked PostgreSQL advisory lock will prevent any other instance from publishing IPNS updates until the session disconnects, causing a silent stall of IPNS publishing across the cluster. What: ipns_publisher.rs IpnsPublisher::run acquires the advisory lock with can_publish() then calls update_and_publish(). If update_and_publish panics (e.g. from an unwrap on a serde error), the release_lock() call is never reached. The lock is not protected by a Drop guard or a catch_unwind boundary. Mitigation requires a defer-like pattern or restructuring the lock acquisition into a RAII guard.
title: IPNS publisher PG advisory lock leaked on panic in update_and_publish
